The wire shapes the operations reference, alphabetically. A field is optional unless marked required.

## ActivityEntry

One `activity_log` row, as returned by `GET /api/activity`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | `string` | yes | `transition|create|delete|relationship_add|relationship_remove|capability_grant|capability_revoke|board_config|work_class|lifecycle|repository|board_move|restore|update|rename|claim|hand_off|release|cancel|purge`. `delete` is an archive. `cancel` is the cancel of a task, with the reason in `details` (KAIROS-T-0362). `purge` is the delete of a task for good: `details` names its code and its title. A change to a team, a delivery stream, a membership or a user has the action `update` (COLLIERY-T-0265). `claim`, `hand_off` and `release` are changes to the claim of a task (KAIROS-T-0359). |
| `actor_id` | `string` | yes | Who did it (user UUID). |
| `agent_key_id` | `string`, nullable | no | The agent key (UUID) of the request that made this change, when an agent made it with the agent key of a person (KAIROS-T-0359). The actor is still the person: show "Alice (agent)". Null for a change made without an agent key, and for each change made before Kairos recorded the key. |
| `details` | `string` | yes | Structured context, e.g. `"column:Draft->Active"`. |
| `entity_archived_at` | `string`, nullable | no | When the item acted on was archived (RFC 3339). Null for a live item, and when `entity_short_code` is null. |
| `entity_id` | `string`, nullable | no | The item acted on (UUID). For a relationship between two items it is the source of the edge, and `details` names the two (KAIROS-T-0638; null in older rows whose source is not known). For an `impacts` link it is the document or the ADR of the link (COLLIERY-T-0269). |
| `entity_repository` | [`ActivityRepository`](#activityrepository), nullable | no |  |
| `entity_short_code` | `string`, nullable | no | The short code of the item acted on (COLLIERY-T-0262), live or archived. Null when the entry is not about an item (a board, a team, a member), and when Kairos has no item with the id. |
| `entity_title` | `string`, nullable | no | The title of the item acted on, as it is now. Null when `entity_short_code` is null. |
| `entity_type` | `string`, nullable | no | `strategy|initiative|task|document|adr`. Null when `entity_id` is null. |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Row id (UUID). |
| `occurred_at` | `string` | yes | RFC 3339. |

## ActivityRepository

The repository that an activity entry is about. It has enough data to link the repository and the pull request or branch of a `forge_event`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `forge` | `string` | yes | `github`, `gitlab` or `other`. |
| `full_name` | `string` | yes | `owner/repo` on GitHub, `group/subgroup/project` on GitLab. |
| `slug` | `string` | yes | Tenant-unique handle. |
| `url` | `string` | yes | The web URL of the repository on the forge. |

## AgentTriage

Who decides the triage of intake on a board (KAIROS-T-0428). Intake is a task in the support lane. Off (the default): an agent proposes with a note, and a person decides. On: an agent moves intake itself, and the activity log names the agent.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agents_decide` | `boolean` | yes |  |
| `board_id` | `string` | yes |  |

The refusal is a 422 `BLOCKED`. When false, the move goes on with a `Kairos-Warning`. False by default. `null` on each other level. |
| `board_level` | `string` | yes | `strategy|initiative|delivery|adr`. |
| `code_prefix` | `string` | yes | The short-code prefix of the board (COLLIERY-T-3099): an item on the board gets a code `{code_prefix}-{type letter}-{number}`. It is set when the board is created and never changes. The default is for the client only: a response of an older server has no prefix. |
| `created_at` | `string` | yes | RFC 3339. |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Board id (UUID). |
| `name` | `string` | yes |  |
| `owner_gate` | `boolean`, nullable | yes | The board policy `owner_gate` of an initiative board (KAIROS-T-0643): when true, an initiative moves into its Active column only with an owner, and the owner of an initiative in Active or Monitoring cannot release it (a hand-off can change it). A refused move or release is a 422 `OWNER_REQUIRED`. True by default. `null` on each other level. |
| `parent_gate` | `boolean`, nullable | yes | The board policy `parent_gate` of a delivery board (KAIROS-T-0641): when true, a task moves into a claims column (Active) only while its parent initiative is active (in Active or Monitoring, or a bucket). A move under an initiative that is not active is a 422 `PARENT_NOT_ACTIVE`. True by default. `null` on each other level. |
| `slug` | `string` | yes |  |
| `team_id` | `string`, nullable | no | Owning team (UUID). A delivery board has one (COLLIERY-T-0230). An ADR board can have one: the ADR board of the team (COLLIERY-T-3102). A strategy or initiative board has one too (KAIROS-T-0440): the one in the create, or its own team. The ADR board of the organization has none. |
| `updated_at` | `string` | yes | RFC 3339. |

## BoardColumn

A board column.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `board_id` | `string` | yes | Owning board (UUID). |
| `claims` | `boolean` | yes | A task that a person moves into this column gets a claim for the person (KAIROS-T-0359). The Active column of a delivery board has it. The default is for the client only: a response of an older server has no `claims`, and it reads as `false`. |
| `created_at` | `string` | yes | RFC 3339. |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Column id (UUID). |
| `is_done` | `boolean` | yes | Occupants count as completed for children-progress rollups (KAIROS-T-0080). The server sends it in each response, so the schema shows it as required (COLLIERY-T-0254). The default is for the client only: a response of an older server has no `is_done`, and it reads as `false`. |
| `keeps_claims` | `boolean` | yes | A task with a claim keeps it in this column, and a task with no claim gets none here (KAIROS-T-0529). The Blocked column of a delivery board has it. The default is for the client only: a response of an older server has no `keeps_claims`. |
| `name` | `string` | yes |  |
| `position` | `integer` | yes | Display ordering, 0-indexed. |
| `removed_at` | `string`, nullable | yes | When this column was REMOVED from its board (RFC 3339), `null` while it is part of the board (KAIROS-T-0161, KAIROS-T-0164). `GET /api/boards/{id}` omits removed columns entirely unless it is asked for them (`?include_removed_columns=true`), so this is `null` on every default read. It is a timestamp only for a caller that wants the column an ARCHIVED card was put away in — the audit fact the soft delete exists to preserve. Named `removed_at`, not `archived_at`: the entity DTOs' `archived_at` is the KAIROS-A-0020 work-item state, and a column is not work. The server sends it in each response, `null` for a live column, so the schema shows it as required and nullable (COLLIERY-T-0256, the pattern of COLLIERY-T-0254). The default is for the client only: a response of an older server has no `removed_at`, and it reads as `None`. |
| `updated_at` | `string` | yes | RFC 3339. |
| `wip_limit` | `integer`, nullable | yes | The most live items that the column should hold (KAIROS-T-0371); `null`: no limit. Kairos does not refuse a move into a column over its limit, and the answer has the header `Kairos-Warning`. The server sends it in each response; the default is for the client only (an older server). |

## BoardDetail

## BoardFlow

The flow metrics of a board for a range (KAIROS-T-0372), from the history of the moves (`activity_log`). An archived item counts until its archive (KAIROS-T-0571), and a cancelled task apart from the done items. The start of an item is its first entry into a start column. A start column has `claims` (Active). With no such column, the column named Active is the start. An item is done in an `is_done` column; its done time is its last entry into one.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ageing` | array of [`FlowAgeingItem`](#flowageingitem) | yes | The work in progress: each item that is not done and has a start, oldest first. |
| `board_id` | `string` | yes | The board (UUID). |
| `board_slug` | `string` | yes |  |
| `cancelled_count` | `integer` | yes | The cancelled tasks of the range, by the time of the cancel. |
| `cumulative_flow` | [`CumulativeFlow`](#cumulativeflow) | yes |  |
| `cycle_time` | [`FlowCycleTime`](#flowcycletime) | yes |  |
| `done_columns` | array of `string` | yes | The done columns, by name. |
| `done_count` | `integer` | yes | The done items of the range (not cancelled). |
| `done_without_start` | `integer` | yes | The done items of the range that never entered a start column (no cycle time). |
| `from` | `string` | yes | The first day of the range, `YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `start_columns` | array of `string` | yes | The start columns, by name. Empty: the board has no start, and no cycle time. |
| `throughput` | array of [`FlowWeek`](#flowweek) | yes | One row for each week of the range (weeks start on Monday, UTC). |
| `to` | `string` | yes | The last day of the range, `YYYY-MM-DD`. |

## BoardItemsResponse

Response of `GET /api/boards/{id}/items`: one page of the items on the board, grouped by column (columns in position order). The order of the items is: the position of the column, then the type, then the short code (COLLIERY-T-0261). The order of the types is: strategy, initiative, task, ADR. Each column is in each page, and a column can have no item on a page.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `blocks_summary` | `object` | yes | Blocked-by/blocks counts keyed by short code, for every item on this board with at least one open `blocks` edge (KAIROS-T-0091) — one grouped query; soft-deleted neighbors never count. An edge is open only while neither end sits in a terminal column (COLLIERY-T-0214): done work does not block and is not blocked, so a card in a terminal column has no entry. The server sends it in each response, so the schema shows it as required (COLLIERY-T-0254). It is an empty map when no item has an open `blocks` edge. The default is for the client only. |
| `board` | [`Board`](#board) | yes |  |
| `children_progress` | `object` | yes | `(done, total)` direct-children counts keyed by the PARENT item's short code, for every item on this board that has children (KAIROS-T-0080) — computed in one grouped query, never per item. The server sends it in each response, so the schema shows it as required (COLLIERY-T-0254). It is an empty map when no item has children. The default is for the client only. |
| `columns` | array of [`BoardColumnItems`](#boardcolumnitems) | yes |  |
| `item_metadata` | `object`, nullable | no | With `with_metadata=true` only (KAIROS-T-0368): the metadata values of each item of the page, keyed by short code and then by the slug of the definition. An item with no value has no entry. Absent when the query did not ask for it. |
| `item_teams` | `object` | yes | The teams of each strategy and initiative of the page, keyed by short code (KAIROS-T-0321), by slug — one query for the board. An item with no team has no entry. The server sends it in each response, so the schema shows it as required. It is an empty map when no item has a team. The default is for the client only. |
| `limit` | `integer` | yes | The `limit` that the server applied. |
| `offset` | `integer` | yes | The `offset` that the server applied. |
| `total` | `integer` | yes | The number of items on the board after the filters, on all pages (COLLIERY-T-0261). The default is for the client only: a response of an older server has no `total`, and it has each item. |

## CascadePreviewResponse

Response of `GET /api/{entity_type}/{short_code}/cascade-preview` (KAIROS-T-0051) â the AUTHORITATIVE KAIROS-A-0001 descendant set a soft-delete of this item WOULD cascade to, computed WITHOUT deleting. ## ChildrenProgressResponse

Response of `GET /api/{entity_type}/{short_code}/children-progress` (KAIROS-T-0080): the item's direct `parent`-edge children grouped by their board column. `done` counts children in `is_done` columns; when NO involved column is flagged, clients must show composition only, never a done percentage.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `by_column` | array of [`ChildColumnProgress`](#childcolumnprogress) | yes | Per-column composition of the children that count, board-then-position order. |
| `cancelled` | `integer` | yes | Cancelled tasks among the children (KAIROS-T-0567). A cancel is "won't do", not done. The default is for the client only: a response of an older server has no `cancelled`. |
| `done` | `integer` | yes | Children sitting in `is_done` columns, less the cancelled tasks (KAIROS-T-0567). An archived child in a done column counts here (KAIROS-T-0571). |
| `has_done_columns` | `boolean` | yes | False when no board hosting the children has a done-flagged column — show composition only, never a done fraction. The server sends it in each response, so the schema shows it as required (COLLIERY-T-0254). The default is for the client only: a response of an older server has no `has_done_columns`, and it reads as `false`. |
| `open` | `integer` | yes | Children that are not done and not cancelled: `total - done - cancelled`. |
| `removed` | `integer` | yes | Children archived from a column that is not done (KAIROS-T-0571). They are not open work, and they are not in `total`. The default is for the client only: a response of an older server has no `removed`. |
| `short_code` | `string` | yes | The parent item's short code. |
| `total` | `integer` | yes | Direct children that count: the live children, and the archived children in a done column (KAIROS-T-0571). Supports/informs material never counts. |

## CodeIndexBreaker

The breaker of the code index builder of a repository (KAIROS-T-0399), as [`Repository`] carries it. The lease of a build job can run out: its server stopped, ran out of memory, or stalled. That trips the breaker, and the build does not run again. Then the builder starts no build of the repository: no update, no first build. A build that a person asks for (`POST /api/repositories/{slug}/code-indexes/rebuild`) resets it.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reason` | `string`, nullable | no | Why: the error of the build job that tripped it. |
| `tripped` | `boolean` | yes | True: the breaker is tripped. |
| `tripped_at` | `string`, nullable | no | When the breaker tripped, RFC 3339. |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `board_id` | `string`, nullable | no | Board to create the task on — SLUG or UUID (KAIROS-T-0150). Optional when `team_id` is given: the task then goes to the delivery board of that team. A request with no board and no team is a 422, with or without a `repository` (COLLIERY-T-0217, COLLIERY-A-0023). Until then a `repository` alone chose the board (KAIROS-T-0104). |
| `column_id` | `string`, nullable | no | The entry column of the board (UUID), the default (KAIROS-T-0566). A task starts there, for every caller: any other column is a 422 that names the entry column. Create the task, then move it. |
| `content` | `string` | no | Markdown content; defaults to empty. |
| `from_team` | `string`, nullable | no | The team that sends the task, by slug or UUID (KAIROS-T-0426). When it is not the team of the board, the task is a request whoever sends it: entry column, support lane. Omit it for today's rule. Kairos does not keep it on the task: name the sending team in the body. |
| `parent` | `string`, nullable | no | The short code of the parent initiative (KAIROS-T-0572). The server writes the `parent` edge in the transaction of the create: a refused parent leaves no task. A retired code finds its item. In a claims column, `parent_gate` applies (KAIROS-A-0040). |
| `repository` | `string`, nullable | no | The repository the task links to (slug or UUID, KAIROS-T-0104). An optional link that says where the code is. It can be any live repository, of any team, and it does not choose the board (COLLIERY-T-0217, COLLIERY-A-0023). `repository` is THE reference field name on the wire (KAIROS-T-0115). The old name `repository_id` is refused, as each field that the route does not know (COLLIERY-T-0259). |
| `task_type` | `string`, nullable | no | `task|bug|tech_debt|support`; defaults to `task`. |
| `team_id` | `string`, nullable | no | A team (UUID). It names the team whose delivery board gets the task, when no board is named (COLLIERY-T-0217); a team without exactly one live delivery board is a 422. With a board it must be that board's team (COLLIERY-T-0216): any other team is a 422, never silently ignored. The BOARD decides the team of the task in both cases. |
| `title` | `string` | yes |  |
| `work_class` | `string`, nullable | no | Planned/Support lane (`planned|support`, KAIROS-T-0077). Defaults to `support` when `task_type` is `support`, else `planned`. |

The server refuses a body with a field that is not in this table ([Errors](../../errors/#a-field-of-the-body)).

## DispatchRule

A dispatch rule of a board. With the trigger `entered_column`, the rule fires when a task that matches the filter enters `column`. On an initiative or a strategy board the item is an initiative or a strategy (KAIROS-T-0719: the event `initiative.entered_column`). With `unblocked` (KAIROS-T-0427), it fires when the last open blocker of a task that matches closes. Then the task must be in `column`, if the rule names one. Kairos sends one signed delivery to the target.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `board_id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `column` | `string`, nullable | no | The name of the column. |
| `column_id` | `string`, nullable | no | `null`: an `unblocked` rule with no column. |
| `created_at` | `string` | yes |  |
| `created_by` | `string` | yes |  |
| `id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `metadata_slug` | `string`, nullable | no | The slug of a metadata definition; `null`: no metadata filter. |
| `metadata_value` | `string`, nullable | no | The value of the metadata that matches (no case, no space at the ends). |
| `repository` | `string`, nullable | no | The slug of the repository; `null`: each repository, and none. |
| `target` | `string` | yes | The name of the target. |
| `target_id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `task_type` | `string`, nullable | no | `task|bug|tech_debt|support`; `null`: each type. |
| `trigger` | `string` | yes | `entered_column`, `unblocked` or `review_changed` (KAIROS-T-0718). |

## Document

A supporting document, as returned by `/api/documents`. Documents do not live on boards: a document is never a card, and it has no column. A document has an owner (COLLIERY-T-0269): the board that the document names (`board_id`). Each document has one (COLLIERY-T-3109). The `lifecycle` is an editorial label (KAIROS-T-0078), and never a board position.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `archived_at` | `string`, nullable | no | When this work was put away, RFC 3339; absent while it is live. Archiving hides work from default listings and nothing more (KAIROS-A-0020) â anything serving an archived row marks it, so an auditor never mistakes it for live work. |
| `board_id` | `string` | yes | The owner board (UUID): the board that the document names (COLLIERY-T-0269). It gives the right to edit the document, and the prefix of its code. Each document has one (COLLIERY-T-3109). |
| `content` | `string` | yes | Markdown content. |
| `created_at` | `string` | yes | RFC 3339. |
| `created_by` | `string` | yes | Creator user id (UUID). |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Entity id (UUID). |
| `impacts` | array of [`Impact`](#impact) | no | The repositories that the document impacts (COLLIERY-T-0269), by slug. An `impacts` link says what the document is about. It gives no right. |
| `lifecycle` | `string` | yes | Editorial lifecycle: `draft|review|published|archived` (KAIROS-T-0078). A label with free transitions â never a board column, never metadata. |
| `notes` | `array`, nullable | no | The notes of the item, in the order of their ids (KAIROS-T-0630). Present on the read of one item (`GET /api/{family}/{short_code}`), empty when the item has none. Absent from lists and from the answers of writes. A note is not part of `content`. |
| `short_code` | `string` | yes | Tenant-scoped short code (`{PREFIX}-D-{NNNN}`). |
| `template_id` | `string`, nullable | no | Template the document was stamped from (UUID), if any. |
| `title` | `string` | yes |  |
| `updated_at` | `string` | yes | RFC 3339. |
| `updated_by` | `string` | yes | Last editor user id (UUID). |
| `version` | `integer` | yes | Optimistic-concurrency version (KAIROS-A-0004). |

## ForgeFilterRule

The two patterns of one field of the forge filter (KAIROS-T-0479). A pattern is a Rust regular expression of 512 bytes or fewer. It can match any part of the value: use `^` and `$` to match all of it. Kairos admits an event when the value matches `include` and does not match `exclude`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `exclude` | `string`, nullable | no | Default empty: exclude nothing. |
| `include` | `string`, nullable | no | Default `.*` (everything). An empty pattern is the same as `.*`. |

## GraphNode

One hydrated node of the focal subgraph.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `archived_at` | `string`, nullable | no | When this node was archived, RFC 3339; absent while it is live. The subgraph is archived-INCLUSIVE (KAIROS-T-0158) — omitting a node used to break the paths THROUGH it, leaving the far side floating with no route back to the focus. Clients must draw a marked node distinctly; drawing it as live is the one wrong answer. |
| `degree` | `integer` | yes | The node's TOTAL edge count — clients render `+N` where `N = degree - edges shown` for undisplayed neighbors. Archived neighbours count, because they are drawn. |
| `depth` | `integer` | yes | Minimum hop distance from the focus (0 = the focus itself). |
| `done` | `boolean` | yes | `true` while this node is in a terminal column, a column with `is_done` (COLLIERY-T-0233). Done work does not block, and nothing blocks done work: a `blocks` edge with a done node at one end is history. Clients must draw that edge differently from an open blocker. `false` for a node with no column. The server sends it in each response, so the schema shows it as required (COLLIERY-T-0247). The default is for the client only: a response of an older server has no `done`, and it reads as `false`. |
| `entity_type` | `string` | yes | `strategy|initiative|task|document|adr`. |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Entity id (UUID). |
| `short_code` | `string` | yes |  |
| `status` | `string` | yes | Board column name for workflow items; editorial lifecycle for documents (the A-0018 two-vocabulary split); `off-board` for ADRs without a board position. |
| `title` | `string` | yes |  |

## IssueImport

An import of the open issues of a repository (KAIROS-T-0487). It is a job of the job queue. `POST` and `GET /api/repositories/{slug}/import-issues` give it.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `created_at` | `string` | yes | When the import was asked for (RFC 3339). |
| `error` | `string`, nullable | no | Why the job failed, or why its last try stopped. |
| `finished_at` | `string`, nullable | no | When the job ended (RFC 3339); `None` while it waits or runs. |
| `interval` | `string` | no | The interval of the cadence of the repository (KAIROS-T-0670): `off`, or `15m`, `1h`, `1d`. |
| `job` | `string` | yes | The id of the job (UUID). |
| `pages` | `integer` | yes | The pages of issues that the job took. |
| `repository` | `string` | yes | The slug of the repository. |
| `result` | [`IssueImportResult`](#issueimportresult) | yes | The counts so far; final when the job is `done`. |
| `state` | `string` | yes | `queued`, `running`, `waiting` (for the rate limit of the forge), `done` or `failed`. |
| `sync` | [`IssueSync`](#issuesync) | no | The sync state of the repository (KAIROS-T-0670). |
| `waiting_until` | `string`, nullable | no | While the job waits for the rate limit of the forge: the time it goes on (RFC 3339). |

## IssueImportResult

The counts of an import of the open issues (KAIROS-T-0483). The job writes them while it runs, and they stay after it ends (KAIROS-T-0487).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filtered` | `integer` | yes | Issues that the forge filter does not admit. |
| `imported` | `integer` | yes | Issues that became a task. |
| `items` | array of `string` | yes | The short codes of the new tasks. |
| `message` | `string` | yes | A sentence for a person. |
| `not_taken` | `integer` | yes | Issues that no task could be made for; `message` says why. |
| `skipped` | `integer` | yes | Issues that were taken before (by a webhook or an earlier import). |

## IssueSync

The sync state of the issue import of a repository (KAIROS-T-0670). Each run lists the open issues and compares them with the record of the issues that Kairos took. An issue with no record becomes a task.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `last_complete_at` | `string`, nullable | no | When the last complete run ended (RFC 3339). |
| `last_error` | `string`, nullable | no | Why the last run stopped, or `None`. The next run tries again. |
| `last_error_at` | `string`, nullable | no | When that error happened (RFC 3339). |
| `last_run_at` | `string`, nullable | no | When the last run ended, complete or not (RFC 3339). |
| `last_run_complete` | `boolean` | no | True: the last run listed every page. False: it stopped half way, or it has not ended. The next run goes on. |
| `last_run_imported` | `integer` | no | The tasks that the last run made. |
| `last_run_listed` | `integer` | no | The open issues that the last run listed. |
| `next_run_at` | `string`, nullable | no | When the next run is due (RFC 3339). `None`: the cadence is off, or the first run is due now. |
| `record_count` | `integer` | no | The issues in the record: those that Kairos took for the repository. |

## KeyScopeRequest

The scope of a new agent key (KAIROS-T-0536). A scope never adds a right. The key does an action when the person can do it and the scope has it.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

The server refuses a body with a field that is not in this table ([Errors](../../errors/#a-field-of-the-body)).

| `capabilities` | array of `string` | yes | The capabilities of the key, sorted. Empty: a read-only key. |

## ListEnvelope_ActivityEntry

The S-0005 list envelope: `{items, total, limit, offset}`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | array of `object` | yes |  |
| `limit` | `integer` | yes | The applied limit. |
| `offset` | `integer` | yes | The applied offset. |
| `total` | `integer` | yes | Rows matching the request, ignoring pagination. Live rows only unless the request asked for archived work as well â `total` and `items` always answer the same question (KAIROS-T-0159). The activity feed counts at most past the larger of 1000 and `offset + limit` (KAIROS-T-0627): a `total` above that bound means "more than the bound". |

## NotReached

One live descendant that an archive does not reach (COLLIERY-T-0234). The archive stops at a descendant that the caller cannot edit, and takes nothing below it. An entry has one of two reasons. `required_capability`, with `board_id`: the caller cannot edit this item. `below`: this item is below the named item, where the archive stopped.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `below` | `string`, nullable | no | The short code of the item above this one where the archive stopped. |
| `board_id` | `string`, nullable | no | The authorization board of the descendant (UUID). |
| `required_capability` | `string`, nullable | no | The `manage_<type>` capability that the caller does not hold. |
| `short_code` | `string` | yes | The short code of the descendant. |

| `read_at` | `string`, nullable | no | When the person read it (RFC 3339); `null` while unread. |

## NotificationSettings

`GET` and `PUT /api/me/notification-settings` response: each kind, and whether it is on. A kind that is off makes no notification for the person.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agent_key_revoked` | `boolean` | yes | An organization admin revoked an agent key of yours (KAIROS-T-0388). |
| `blocked_again` | `boolean` | yes | A blocker of an item that you have the claim on (or own, or made) left a done column, so it blocks again (KAIROS-T-0568). |
| `blocker_cancelled` | `boolean` | yes | A person cancelled a task that blocks an item that you have the claim on, own or made. The cancelled task still blocks (KAIROS-T-0567). |
| `blocker_cleared` | `boolean` | yes | A blocker of an item that you have the claim on (or own) is done, archived or purged, or its `blocks` link is removed. |
| `cancelled` | `boolean` | yes | A person cancelled a task that you created. |
| `claim_dropped` | `boolean` | yes | A person left the organization, so their claim on a task of the board of your team ended. The task is free (KAIROS-T-0531). |
| `claim_stale` | `boolean` | yes | A claim had no write and no state change for some days: your claim, or a claim on a task of an initiative that you own (KAIROS-T-0531). |
| `delivery_failing` | `boolean` | yes | A webhook target that you own was turned off after failed deliveries (KAIROS-T-0384). |
| `hand_off` | `boolean` | yes | A person handed off the claim of a task to you. |
| `key_expiring` | `boolean` | yes | An agent key of yours, or a key of a service account of your organization (you are an admin), expires within 7 days (KAIROS-T-0540). |
| `mention` | `boolean` | yes | A person wrote `@your_user_name` in a note or in the content of an item. |
| `p0_bug` | `boolean` | yes | A bug with the priority P0 (critical) is on the board of your team. |
| `proposal_decided` | `boolean` | yes | A person confirmed or rejected an edge proposal that you made (KAIROS-T-0558). |
| `watch` | `boolean` | yes | An item that you watch, or a child of an item that you watch with its children, moved, was edited, got a note, or is done (KAIROS-T-0736). |

## ProgressCounts

A `(done, total)` children rollup (KAIROS-T-0080). `done` counts the children sitting in `is_done` columns. An archived child counts by the column that it was archived from (KAIROS-T-0571).

|---|---|---|---|
| `cancelled` | `integer` | yes | Cancelled tasks among the children (KAIROS-T-0567). The default is for the client only: a response of an older server has no `cancelled`. |
| `done` | `integer` | yes | Children in a done column, less the cancelled tasks (KAIROS-T-0567). |
| `has_done` | `boolean` | yes | False when no board hosting the children has a done-flagged column — clients show composition only, never a done fraction. The server sends it in each response, so the schema shows it as required (COLLIERY-T-0254). The default is for the client only: a response of an older server has no `has_done`, and it reads as `false`. |
| `open` | `integer` | yes | Children that are not done and not cancelled. |
| `removed` | `integer` | yes | Children archived from a column that is not done (KAIROS-T-0571): not open work, and not in `total`. The default is for the client only. |
| `total` | `integer` | yes |  |

## RelatedItem

One hydrated neighbor of an item in the relationship graph.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `archived_at` | `string`, nullable | no | When this neighbour was archived, RFC 3339; absent while it is live. Relationship lists are archived-INCLUSIVE (KAIROS-T-0158): an item's edges describe what it contains and depends on, and dropping an archived endpoint silently shrinks that answer. The row therefore comes back with this marker, and every renderer must show it — ADR-20: anything serving an archived row says so, or an auditor mistakes it for live work. |
| `cancelled` | `boolean` | no | `true` when the neighbour is a cancelled task (KAIROS-T-0567); absent otherwise. A cancelled task is in a done column, so `done` is `true` too. But a cancelled blocker is unresolved: it still blocks, and a client shows it as cancelled, not done. |
| `done` | `boolean` | no | `true` when this neighbour sits in a terminal column (a column the board marks `is_done`); absent otherwise (COLLIERY-T-0214). Done work does not block and is not blocked, so a `blocks` edge to a done neighbour is history, not an open blocker: the board's `blocks_summary` does not count it. The edge still comes back here, because the list is the record, and every renderer of a `blocks` neighbour must show this marker. It follows the neighbour's current column; nothing is stored. |
| `entity_type` | `string` | yes | `strategy|initiative|task|document|adr`. |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The neighbor's entity id (UUID). |
| `relationship_id` | `string` | yes | The edge's id (UUID) — pass to `DELETE /api/relationships/{id}`. |
| `short_code` | `string` | yes | The neighbor's short code. |
| `title` | `string` | yes | The neighbor's title. |

## RelatedProposal

One related-work **proposal**: a claim, its evidence, and nothing asserted. There is no similarity here, deliberately. `score` is a fused rank and is comparable **within one response only**; a caller comparing it to a constant would be reading a number that has no fixed meaning. The measurements behind that are in `kairos_core::retrieval`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `claim` | `string` | yes | `implicit_dependency` | `near_duplicate` | `prior_art`. |
| `entity_type` | `string` | yes | Its entity type. |
| `score` | `number` | yes | Fused rank score. Comparable within this response and nowhere else. |
| `short_code` | `string` | yes | The proposed item's short code. |
| `title` | `string` | yes | Its title. |
| `why` | `string` | yes | Why, in a sentence a person can disagree with. |

| `proposals` | array of [`RelatedProposal`](#relatedproposal) | yes | Bounded, best first. Possibly empty — which is one search coming up short, not proof that nothing is related. |
| `short_code` | `string` | yes | The item asked about. |
| `vector` | `boolean` | yes | Whether vector search contributed. False means a **degraded** answer: no embeddings yet, a model change, an unreachable provider. The answer is still useful; it will have missed work phrased differently. |

| `short_code` | `string` | yes | The code of the item. |
| `watching` | `boolean` | yes | `true` when the caller watches the item. |
| `with_children` | `boolean` | yes | `true` when the watch includes the children of the item (its `parent` edges, one level). `false` when the caller does not watch. |

## WatchedItem

One watch of the caller, in `GET /api/me/watches`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `archived` | `boolean` | yes | `true` when the item is archived. |
| `created_at` | `string` | yes | When the caller started the watch (RFC 3339). |
| `entity_type` | `string` | yes | `strategy|initiative|task|document|adr`. |
| `short_code` | `string` | yes | The code of the item now. |
| `title` | `string` | yes | The title of the item now. |
| `with_children` | `boolean` | yes | `true` when the watch includes the children of the item. |

## WebhookDelivery

One delivery of the log, with its tries.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `created_at` | `string` | yes |  |
| `event` | `string` | yes | `task.entered_column`, `task.unblocked` or `ping`. |
| `finished_at` | `string`, nullable | no |  |
| `id` | `string` | yes | The id; the value of `X-Kairos-Delivery`. |
| `last_error` | `string`, nullable | no |  |
| `log` | array of [`WebhookDeliveryTry`](#webhookdeliverytry) | yes | Each try, oldest first. |
| `next_try_at` | `string`, nullable | no |  |
| `response_code` | `integer`, nullable | no |  |
| `rule_id` | `string`, nullable | no | The rule that sent it; `null` for a test delivery. |
| `short_code` | `string`, nullable | no | The code of the task now; `null` when there is no task. |
| `status` | `string` | yes | `pending|delivered|failed|skipped`. |
| `target_id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `tries` | `integer` | yes |  |

## WebhookDeliveryTry

One try of a delivery.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | `string` | yes |  |
| `duration_ms` | `integer` | yes |  |
| `error` | `string`, nullable | no |  |
| `ok` | `boolean` | yes | True: the target answered with a 2xx code. |
| `response_code` | `integer`, nullable | no |  |
| `try_number` | `integer` | yes | 1 for the first try. |

## WebhookTarget

A webhook target of a board: a URL. Kairos sends signed deliveries to it. The secret is never in this type: Kairos shows it one time, in [`CreatedWebhookTarget`].

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `board_id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `consecutive_failures` | `integer` | yes | The failed tries in a row. |
| `created_at` | `string` | yes |  |
| `created_by` | `string` | yes |  |
| `disabled_at` | `string`, nullable | no |  |
| `disabled_reason` | `string`, nullable | no |  |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | yes | False: Kairos turned the target off after failed tries, and sends nothing to it until a board manager turns it on again. Then Kairos sends the deliveries that it skipped (KAIROS-T-0577). |
| `id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `name` | `string` | yes |  |
| `redelivered` | `integer`, nullable | no | Only in the answer of `enable` and `redeliver` (KAIROS-T-0577): the number of `skipped` deliveries that Kairos queued again. |
| `url` | `string` | yes | The URL. A person who cannot configure the board gets it with no query and no fragment. |

## WorkBlocker

An open blocker of an item of the work.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `short_code` | `string` | yes |  |
| `title` | `string` | yes |  |

## WorkBoard

The board of an item of the work.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | yes | Board id (UUID). |
| `name` | `string` | yes |  |
| `slug` | `string` | yes |  |

## WorkItem

One item of the work. No item is in a done column.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `blockers` | array of [`WorkBlocker`](#workblocker) | no | The open blockers: the items, not in a done column, with a `blocks` edge to this item. |
| `board` | [`WorkBoard`](#workboard) | yes | The board of the item. |
| `claim` | [`TaskClaim`](#taskclaim), nullable | no |  |
| `column_id` | `string` | yes | The column of the item: id (UUID) and name. |
| `column_name` | `string` | yes |  |
| `entity_type` | `string` | yes | `strategy`, `initiative` or `task`. |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Entity id (UUID). |
| `owner` | [`ItemOwner`](#itemowner), nullable | no |  |
| `reasons` | array of `string` | yes | Why the item is in the work: `owned`, `claimed`, `under_my_initiative`, `blocked_by_my_work`, and `unclaimed` (the last stop of a stand-up). |
| `short_code` | `string` | yes |  |
| `state` | `string` | yes | `todo`, `active` or `blocked`. Blocked: the item has an open blocker, or it is in a column named Blocked. |
| `title` | `string` | yes |  |
